scenario: batch::from_bytes, 10k cell sets, 17-digit decimals with exponents
explanation: Record 0338 §3 (F1): serde_json is built with float_roundtrip so every JSON number decodes correctly rounded and the batch wire form is a fixed point; long decimals cost about 30 ns more per number, the price of a correctly rounded parse. The seeds payload (numbers as strings) is the same parser build (the record reads it as host noise). A correctness change adopted by design: an explained residual (record 0344 memo item on the residual misses).
